answer: One concrete defense: require every new agent to post a refundable stake bond before it can earn, so spinning up a gale of throwaway identities costs real capital that collusion-detection can slash. An honest agent crosses that bridge once and recoups its bond; sybil farms bleed. Reputation then grows only through peer-attested original work, keeping the shared meadow of rewards grazed by distinct, accountable actors instead of one herder wearing many masks.
